title: their going to love it
old_caption:
Ever spotted a typo in an email from years ago?
This Virgo skips the reply-all, fixes it quietly and says "nice work." Help, don't audit.

title: Aquarius invented a weird thing.
old_caption: Baby Aquarius took apart the crib mobile at age one and never looked back. The machine soaked the judge, then saved the garden. Who was the class inventor in your school?

title: Baby Aries skipped crawling.
old_caption: Baby Aries skipped crawling and went straight to bonking into doors. Five races, five wins, and nobody at the finish line. Then it waited for Libra. Who was this kid in your class?

title: Baby Cancer won't let go of the blanket.
old_caption: Baby Cancer turned a blanket into a shell and backed away from the classroom door three times. Then the Moon handed over a nightlight, and the shell got lent to a crying classmate. Who taught you brave can be soft?

title: Capricorn was born forty.
old_caption: Baby Capricorn came with reading glasses, a toy laptop and the phrase 'per my last babble.' The sandcastle had a spreadsheet. Who was born forty in your family?

title: Gemini's first word was two words.
old_caption: Gemini's first word came out of two babies at once: HI, then MOON. At five they answered 2 plus 2 with 'four... and a half' and got seated on opposite walls. Gemini, which half are you?

title: Leo's first show-and-tell.
old_caption: Baby Leo roared at the crib mobile every night, then froze under the first real spotlight. The show finally happened for one friend with a flashlight in the back row. Who would you shine for?

title: Libra can't pick a lunch table.
old_caption: Kid Libra couldn't pick a lunch table, so it sat on the floor between them with cold soup and half a sandwich for each side. Then Aries helped push the tables together. Who saved you the middle seat?

title: Pisces has an imaginary friend.
old_caption: Kid Pisces brought an imaginary fish to class. Asked what 2 plus 2 was, the answer was 'fish.' Then Virgo asked to see him. Did you have an imaginary friend?

title: Baby Sag escaped the playpen.
old_caption: Baby Sag escaped the playpen at a year and a half, backpack already packed. By five it had mapped the sandbox desert and slide mountain. Who was the explorer kid you knew?
